Where each fixture came from. All are checked against autognomus
b4ea408, whose
autognomus-hub/tests/http_tasks.rs drives the same JSON end to end. Any
difference from the gateway is a bug on one side.

public-node-external.json
public-node-loop.json
    autognomus-gateway/src/domain/workflow.rs: `PublicNode` (tagged by
    `kind`, lowercase), `RetrySpec`, `PublicLoopExit`.

feature-from-ticket.workflow.json
    Written by hand from the dev workflows design (4.3, 4.4) as the body
    vetinari registers for one feature-from-ticket run, in the shape of
    autognomus-gateway/src/domain/workflow.rs (`PublicNode`,
    `PublicEdge`, `PublicTrigger`).

claim-preflight-first.json
claim-implement-rework.json
claim-open-pr.json
    autognomus-workflow-api/src/task.rs (`Task`, `TaskId` as
    `<run>~<instance>~<attempt>`) and autognomus-workflow/src/run.rs (the
    loop envelope `{input, iteration, previous?}`). `config` is the
    matching node's config from feature-from-ticket.workflow.json.

run-graph.json
instance-statuses.json
    autognomus-workflow-api/src/view.rs: `RunGraphView` (`run`, `seq`,
    `nodes`, `edges`, `instances`), `GraphNode` with `GraphNodeKind`
    flattened and tagged by `kind`, `InstanceView` with `InstanceStatus`
    flattened and tagged by `status`, and autognomus-workflow-api/src/
    graph.rs `Edge`. A loop instance finishes `done` with branch `done`
    or `exhausted` at attempt 1. Edges are what compile emits.

run-view.json
workflow-runs.json
    autognomus-workflow-api/src/view.rs (`RunView`, `RunStateView`
    flattened and tagged by `state`, outputs keyed by instance) and
    autognomus-gateway/src/http/runs.rs (`GET /v1/runs/{id}`,
    `GET /v1/workflows/{id}/runs` returning `[RunView]`).

workflows.json
    autognomus-gateway/src/domain/workflow.rs (`WorkflowView`, with
    `callback` left out when unset) and autognomus-gateway/src/http/
    workflows.rs (`GET /v1/workflows`). Only `id` is read.

run-events.sse
    autognomus-gateway/src/http/run_events.rs (`event:` is the subject
    without `ag.run.`, the data is the event's payload, and `resync` ends
    the stream) and autognomus-workflow/src/service/events.rs,
    service/external.rs and service.rs (every node event carries run,
    workflow, instance, at, seq and a numeric attempt, plus its extras;
    `loop.iteration` carries run, workflow, instance, at, seq and
    iteration). Run events carry run, workflow and seq; `cancelled` adds
    `at`, `failed` adds `node` and `error`.

Error bodies
    autognomus-gateway/src/http/error.rs: `{"error":{"code","message"}}`,
    with `reason` beside `error` on a 409 (`stale`, `gone`). An engine
    that is down is 502 `workflow_unavailable`, one that is slow 504
    `workflow_timeout`; 400 is a malformed id or queue, 422 an output
    that is not an object.
